_comment: COUPLING tier-2. Exercises check_interface_balance in BOTH directions on hand-built exports — no solver, so a slow backend cannot hide a regression in the validator. Quiet direction: a correct frictionless contact interface (normal tractions cancelling exactly, tangential at roundoff on both sides) and a symmetric flux profile whose net is float noise must produce NO warning; a per-component comparison without a magnitude floor reports the frictionless case as ~92% unbalanced on a physically perfect interface. Loud direction: half the flux arriving is caught; a same-sign export is caught AND named as a SIGN-CONVENTION error rather than left as a bare imbalance; a missing normal_fluxes array reports 'NOT CHECKED' rather than passing silently. Sixth case is the guard on the guard — a wrong normal component under the same frictionless shape must still be caught, so the two quiet cases cannot be satisfied by a check that never fires.
